title.narrative: De-risking Facility for Energy Performance Contracting in Mauritius

description.narrative: Mauritius aims for a 10% economy-wide energy efficiency improvement by 2030, facing challenges from limited investment and a nascent Energy Performance Contracting (EPC)/Energy Services Companies (ESCO) market with high perceived risks. To address this, the project introduces a financing mechanism with a first loss guarantee for banks lending to ESCOs, enhancing collateral and reducing risks. Coordinated with other donor-funded programs, the initiative will establish a robust framework for EPC implementation, including setting up and grading ESCOs, and standardizing EPC contracts. It also involves capacity building for local professionals and awareness campaigns to boost energy efficiency investments. The project aims to significantly reduce GHG emissions and promote energy efficiency as a viable investment, leveraging substantial debt and equity financing to achieve these goals.
